purpose: Analyze the exact Shaders launch reference, including native music/SFX, before the Grifon close recreation pilot.

input.nativeAudio: Stereo AAC 48kHz; preserved, not muted or replaced

analyzer.prompt: Exact unchanged ANALYSIS_PROMPT from the existing analyzer
analyzer.canonicalToolChanges: None. A task-local adapter would add only the two proposed bounds after approval.

budget.preflight: Verify exact input/tool hashes; verify model output bound semantics; count exact upload+prompt input tokens before generating; abort on count>60000, unavailable auth, failed upload, changed input or uncertain cap. No alternate model/provider or retry.

pass: Existing specificity validator accepts the JSON, including at least three timestamped numeric why-it-works claims.
Native audio is supplied; music/SFX/voice/silence findings identify times and preserve confidence. No invented transcript if speech is absent.
Manual frame-indexed cut/type/material/camera observations cross-check the semantic result. Model times do not replace source frame measurements.
Token usage and computed cost are recorded; cost<=0.25 and one attempted generation maximum.
fail: Missing audio, vague result, unsupported sound labels or contradictory visual claims.
Input drift, unbounded billing, missing authorized credential channel or API failure. Stop; no automatic retry.
limitations: Gemini audio findings are a machine analysis hypothesis. Root cannot directly hear audio through this runtime. No commercial soundtrack rights or Grifon creative approval is implied.
